title: How Tabs Chocolate went from banned on every ad platform to $5M with TikTok organic and affiliate armies
summary: Oliver Brocato explains how Tabs Chocolate grew with no paid ads. He moved from one-off influencers to one-creator-per-account TikTok pages, then added a 2,000-person affiliate Discord. He also covers why experience compounds into intuition, why focus beats jumping between projects, and how a public build-in-public Twitter journey brings in inbound deals.

principles.text: Don't stack creators on one TikTok account; scale horizontally with one creator per brand account.
principles.quote: scale horizontally across multiple accounts bringing on multiple independent creators matching it one Creator per one account

principles.text: One-off influencer posts give spikes then zero. Build a repeatable system for a baseline instead.
principles.quote: we would see the post would go up Revenue would spike and then as soon as like you know things start to chill off Revenue would be back at zero

principles.text: Gamify an affiliate Discord with commissions, base pay and raffles to multiply content distribution.
principles.quote: they get a 20 Commission on any sell that they make

principles.text: Beginners should learn TikTok organic: it takes almost no money to go from zero to six or seven figures.
principles.quote: familiarize yourself with Tick Tock organic um like learn learn that skill

principles.text: Document your journey publicly and the best clients come inbound; do exceptional work and partners line up.
principles.quote: all of our clients have been inbound man um you know since since I started tabs um about like two years ago um I've been like documenting my whole entire Journey on Twitter

principles.text: Eight-figure operators aren't smarter; their repeated reps build intuition. Stay on one thing long enough to compound.
principles.quote: it boils down to to your experience which leads to intuition which leads to success
